message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on a cotton sheet set with a lace insertion. The set is put up for retail sale, so GRI 3(b) applies and the essential character must be determined. The flat sheet and fitted sheet are the main components, and the set is classified as bed linen.

Relevant heading: 6302. Subheadings:
- 6302.21 covers other bed linen, printed.
- 6302.31 covers other bed linen of cotton, not printed.
- 6302.31.10 covers cotton bed linen, not napped, "Containing any embroidery, lace, braid, edging, trimming, piping or applique work."
- 6302.31.20 covers napped.
- 6302.31.30 covers other, not napped.

The 6302.31 breakouts are:
- 6302.31.10: Pillowcases and bolsters cases.
- 6302.31.20: Sheets (?).

These breakouts are uncertain. The 6302.31 structure I recall is:
- 6302.31.10: Containing any embroidery, lace, braid, edging, trimming, piping or applique work.
- 6302.31.20: Other, napped.
- 6302.31.30: Other, not napped...

Elsewhere I recall 6302.31.9010 for other and 6302.31.9020 for pillowcases. In current HTS, 6302.31.10 is "Containing any embroidery, lace, braid, edging, trimming, piping or applique work," with statistical suffixes 6302.31.1010 for pillowcases and 6302.31.1020 for sheets. Then 6302.31.20 is "Other: Pillowcases" and 6302.31.30 is "Other: Sheets"? I think the actual structure is:
- 6302.31.10: Containing any embroidery... (statistical suffixes 10 sheets? 20 pillowcases?)
- 6302.31.20: Other, napped
- 6302.31.30: Other, not napped...

The ruling likely selected 6302.31.1000 or a suffix. The insertion is polyester embroidery, which counts as embroidery/lace trimming, so the set falls under the "containing embroidery" provision. The set is mostly sheets, and the likely statistical suffix for this is 6302.31.1020 or 6302.31.1000.

I'll go with 6302.31.1000.

{"hts_code": "6302.31.1000", "reason": "A retail-packaged set of non-printed 100% cotton bed linen whose flat sheet and pillowcases contain polyester openwork embroidery/lace insertion is classified as other cotton bed linen containing embroidery, lace or trimming under 6302.31.10."}
